close_reason: Destroy re-fetch comment replaced with RFC 8620 §5.3 sequential-operation rationale as specified
description: In handle_mailbox_set, the destroy loop uses a second get_objects call (mailboxes_after_mutations) rather than the pre-mutation all_mailboxes snapshot for the child-mailbox check. A contributor might 'optimize' this to use the existing snapshot. But RFC 8620 §5.3 requires create/update/destroy to operate in sequence, so a mailbox created earlier in the same request could be a child of the mailbox being destroyed. Using the pre-mutation snapshot would miss that child and allow destroying a non-empty parent, corrupting the hierarchy. The second fetch is correct and intentional.
title: Mailbox/set destroy re-fetches mailboxes after create/update to catch same-request newly-created children
